_about: season_finishes.csv keys each row on a slug of that SEASON's display name, so a
player whose listed name changes (Jr./Sr./III suffixes, Christopher vs Chris,
De'Von vs Devon, Miller-Hines) has his seasons split across several ids and the
rookie id in rookie_drafts.csv only finds some of them. Every alias below was
checked against nflverse stats_player_reg_<season>.csv: alias rows and target rows
are the same nflverse player_id (gsis), and no alias row predates the rookie year.

rookie_renames._why: The 2024 rookie is Frank Gore Jr.; 'frank-gore' is his father's id in season_finishes.csv (2017-2020). Gore Jr. has no NFL stat line through 2025.

season_additions._why: Absent from nflverse weekly player_stats, present in stats_player_reg_2018.csv (RB, CIN). Points use build_fantasy_data.py's formula on those totals.
Absent from nflverse weekly player_stats, present in stats_player_reg_2019.csv (RB, MIA).
